name: Further
description: Query your funds in intricate detail with the Further MCP. Once connected, you can check current fund performance, review capital calls and distributions, look up portfolio company holdings, analyse financial and accounting data, and answer ad hoc questions, all through a secure connection to your live Further data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Further to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Further to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.joinfurther.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Further MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Further lists 39 MCP tools, including get_balance_sheet, get_bank_operation_reconciled_actions, get_capital_action, get_cash_flow_statement, get_close, get_commitment_capital_balance_and_payments, get_commitment_capital_history, get_commitment_fees, get_commitment_holdings, get_commitment_incomes_and_expenses, get_commitment_metrics, and get_commitment_pcap.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Further?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Further in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Further requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Further is developed by Further. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
